catchup-step-births.reason: PauseAndCatchup's catch-up advance (the missed time and the frame's own, split by Time.maximumParticleDeltaTime): times and the held state match, but a rate birth due exactly at a step's end of that advance falls one step apart, so the count differs by one for a few frames and the particles' summed lifetimes and positions with it (cull/catchup_*).

bake-scratch-memory.reason: A texture passed in keeps, past the baked bytes, whatever the Editor's scratch buffer held (an uninitialized fill, bake/givenfloat); an RGBA32 one shows the floats' bytes, where a billboard normal component the Editor computes as about 4e-8 is 0 in Unbound (bake/given). Texture sizes match (bakesize/*, bakecap/*). Mesh particles' indices textures likewise: past the index pairs a 16-bit bake holds (meshindex/cube16/baketexture/default, matched up to there) and, with PerParticle, all of it (bake/mesh/perparticle/indices, meshindex/*/baketexture/perparticle: zeros in one capture of this release, float bits of the vertex data in another); Unbound writes zeros past the pairs and the first particle's indices with PerParticle.

freeform-stretching.reason: Freeform stretching with rotateWithStretchDirection, baked without BakePosition/BakeRotationAndScale (the emitter's frame) from a rotated emitter scaled (1.5, 0.5, 2) (freemove/transform_freeform/*/front): the particle moving along the emitter's y turns by another angle than in Unity; the same particles baked in world space (front/transform) and from the side camera match, as do all freenorm/transform/* bakes. Open.

stretched-normals.reason: Stretched quads seen from the side camera, or of a rotated non-uniformly scaled emitter: positions match, the normals differ by up to 1e-3 (stretch/*/side/normals, stretch/transform/*/normals, freenorm/vdepth/plain: a particle moving along the view, 5e-4); the normal of a particle at rest in a sorted system seen from the side is the camera's down in the Editor, its view direction in Unbound (stretch/sort_*/side/normals); with BakeRotationAndScale a rotated, non-uniformly scaled emitter's quads lie up to 0.07 apart (stretch/transform/front/transform/positions).

prewarm-end-tie.reason: A prewarm ends exactly on a loop's end (prewarm/*): its float clock lands a few microseconds before the end in the Editor and just past it in Unbound, or the other way round, for some spans (prewarm/chain, birth_child6). Right after Play the reported time is the duration against nearly 0, and a burst or rate birth due at the loop's start fires inside the prewarm in one and in the first update in the other, so that particle's age and the emission order differ by one prewarm step for as long as it lives. An insignificant float tie: every other prewarm control ends on the same side and matches.

prewarm-equal-age-order.reason: Prewarmed Birth children of a rate parent (prewarm/birth_rate) whose ages are equal to within a float bit sort in another order (the record sorts by age): ages, positions and seeds match as a set; an order-only float tie.

prewarm-long-child-catchup.reason: Prewarmed parents whose Birth child lives 6, 8 or 12 s (prewarm/birth_child6, birth_child8, birth_child12): the Editor keeps fewer of the children emitted long before the prewarm's end (33, 43 and 24 children against Unbound's 36, 48 and 72, which keeps every child born within its lifetime of the end); with child lifetimes up to 4 s every child matches. Open, prewarm only: the catch-up of children in long Simulate calls (catchup/*, 4.5 to 13 s) matches.

collision-cache-small-budget.reason: World collisions at Medium and Low quality with QualitySettings.particleRaycastBudget at 2, shared by both systems (collide/cache/budget2_*): which particle queries in a given frame is unresolved, so the cached plane a particle meets comes from another particle than in the Editor. Medium bounces in the same frames, its positions within 1e-3; Low misses or takes some bounces in other frames. With the default budget (collide/world/slope_medium, slope_low) and in a system advanced only by Simulate (collide/cache/simulate_medium) every value matches.

collision-cache-moved-collider.reason: A Low system whose collider goes away after its planes are cached (collide/cache/gone_low): in the Editor one particle, alone in its voxel column, does not meet the plane its query found before the collider left, while the other particles still bounce off theirs; Unbound's cache keeps that plane and bounces the particle in frame 15. Why the Editor's particle passes it is unresolved. High and Medium (collide/cache/gone_high, gone_medium), static colliders moved within reach (collide/cache/moved_*) and every other frame match.
